name: Texas Gas Southern Indiana Market Lateral
researcher_notes: No existing row: the Texas Gas main line row covers only the main line, and the 2018 Clarksville row is a different project. The Federal Register notice of 17 February 2015 for FERC docket CP15-14 describes about 29.9 miles of 20-inch pipe plus about 0.9 mile of 10-inch pipe, running from Henderson County, Kentucky to two industrial customers in Posey County, Indiana, with about 166,000 MMBtu per day of firm capacity. The EIA project table (Oct 2025 release, Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 819) lists the project as a completed lateral, in service 17 June 2016, 30 miles, with 10 inches, 53.5 and cost 63 recorded in other columns. The EIA diameter of 10 inches and capacity of 53.5 do not match the notice, so the staged diameter is 20 inches from the notice and capacity is left blank. As-built length was not found, so 29.9 miles is the proposed figure. The EIA Aug 2026 release did not contain this row; the Oct 2025 release is cited. Both sources are government documents but of different origin. A web search for an operator in-service release was not possible because the session limit was hit. Owner and parent copied from the existing Texas Gas row; no exact entity match for Texas Gas Transmission. Route not researched. Length is above the 15.5 mile floor. Reviewer should confirm the as-built length and the diameter in the FERC order or the in-service filing.
